blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–No one enjoyed Converge’s breakthrough semifinal appearance more than Calvin Abueva. Even after getting ejected for two technical fouls, Abueva wound up having the last laugh as the FiberXers eliminated the Rain or Shine Elasto Painters, 120-109, to win their 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals series in four games. Abueva, who shouted “Tapon basura!” while walking down the hallway at Smart Araneta Coliseum after getting tossed, taunted the Rain or Shine bench as the final seconds ticked away. His ejection came after he was called for flopping instead of an offensive foul. His insults were mainly directed at Rain or […]...
